scope: All 233 Python files listed in the historical source manifest
hash_contract: audit_original_sha256 hashes historical local bytes; verified_main_blob_sha256 hashes unfiltered Git blobs. LF normalization is explicit. Seven files also had trailing blank lines removed before publication; historical hashes remain unchanged.
limitations: This verifies the recorded source snapshot against the specified Git commit, not per-process loaded modules or dependencies.
Seven historical byte forms were reconstructed using only EOL/EOF candidates and verified against the original SHA256. They are explanatory reconstructions, not original archived source files.
No model calls, product writes, historical judgement changes, or confidence adjustments were performed.
